measurement_policy: MEASURED = produced by running one of the scripts in tools/bench over the shipped sources (exact counts derived from real code, not estimates). STATIC = read from source and verified by hand, line-referenced. No runtime/browser/frame-time measurement was possible in this pass: tools/bench/results/startup-200trk-20261003-212819.json shows the only existing bench run aborted with 'Another instance of NeDotify is already running', so it contains no usable numbers.

section1_raf_loops.animates: 2D canvas particle field in #particles-bg (position fixed, inset -25px, z-index 1) - ambient background behind every view
section1_raf_loops.target_fps: 24 default (particles.js:17 targetFps); setParticlesFps clamps 5..30; nedotify:efficiency_state forces 15 (particles.js:484); battery saver 15 (particles.js:493)
section1_raf_loops.throttle_mechanism: elapsed < frameInterval -> return (particles.js:408-414) - the rAF still fires at display rate, only drawing is throttled
section1_raf_loops.checks_other_view: no - #particles-bg is fixed and covers all views (base.css:1425-1434)
section1_raf_loops.runs_when_minimized: no - document.hidden check inside animate() sets animFrameId = null and stops
section1_raf_loops.listener_leak: YES - initParticles() re-creates onResize/onMouseMove/onMouseLeave/onMiniPlayerToggled every call and removeEventListener()s the NEW closure, so each call permanently adds 1 window resize + 1 window mousemove + 1 window mouseleave + 1 window nedotify:mini_player_toggled listener (particles.js:263-305). initParticles() is called from 7 sites in settings.js (124, 129, 134, 202, 614, 689, 1315) and the 3 particle sliders call it on EVERY unthrottled `input` event (settings.js:643-646 -> 124/129/134).
section1_raf_loops.per_frame_work: ctx.clearRect(full viewport) + up to 80 drawImage calls from cached sprites (particleCount capped at 80, or 25 on <=4-core)

section1_raf_loops.checks_other_view: yes - stops when no canvas is visible: offsetParent !== null && closest('.view-page').classList.contains('active') (visualizer.js:263-275)
section1_raf_loops.checks_mini_player: indirect - #main-content is display:none in mini-player mode (base.css:2280-2295) so offsetParent is null
section1_raf_loops.idle_behaviour: when paused it deliberately keeps re-requesting rAF and runs a gentle idle animation (visualizer.js:277-280) - this is a permanent 24fps loop while the player view/home view is visible, even paused
section1_raf_loops.per_frame_work: targets.forEach: 2x offsetParent read (layout read) + 2x closest('.view-page') DOM walk + optional canvas redraw; getCachedPrimaryRgb() caches getComputedStyle for 5s (visualizer.js:178-187)

section1_raf_loops.animates: pb/pp/mp progress-fill transforms, 3x aria-valuenow, 3x time textContent, and renderWaveforms() canvas redraw
section1_raf_loops.target_fps: 30 default (progressThrottleMs = 1000/30, player.js:1051); setUiFps clamps 10..60 and rewrites --ui-fps and --ui-transition-duration (player.js:1053-1059)
section1_raf_loops.checks_other_view: no - the player bar is global
section1_raf_loops.runs_when_minimized: PARTIAL - the loop RE-SCHEDULES itself while hidden (player.js:1067) instead of parking; it only skips the body. It is therefore still an armed rAF chain while minimized.
section1_raf_loops.per_frame_work: 3 style.transform writes + 3 setAttribute + 3 textContent + renderWaveforms() per throttled frame

section1_raf_loops.animates: --orbit-glow-opacity / --orbit-glow-scale CSS vars on #player-bar and .player-glass-card (Web Audio bass FFT)
section1_raf_loops.checks_document_hidden: via-cb - loop() itself has no check; syncOrbitGlowState() is bound to visibilitychange (2031) and evaluates !document.hidden (1935)
section1_raf_loops.checks_other_view: no - runs on every view while playing
section1_raf_loops.runs_when_minimized: no, provided the visibilitychange handler fires
section1_raf_loops.per_frame_work: analyserNode.getByteFrequencyData + 4 style.setProperty calls -> invalidates style for the whole player-bar subtree

section1_raf_loops.animates: 3 absolutely positioned gradient orbs (600x600, 650x650, 450x450 px) in #aura-orbs-container
section1_raf_loops.checks_document_hidden: via-cb - body.unfocused-animations-disabled sets animation-play-state: paused (base.css:3714-3717), and efficiency.js:133 sets that class when document.hidden and limit_state === 'minimize' (the default)
section1_raf_loops.checks_other_view: no - fixed inset 0 behind the whole app
section1_raf_loops.runs_when_minimized: no under the default efficiency settings; yes if unfocused_disable_animations is turned off
section1_raf_loops.per_frame_work: 3 compositor layers translating a transform; each orb also has contain: strict + will-change: transform

section1_raf_loops.target_fps: one-shot 0.3s per row, staggered by item.style.animationDelay = min(index*0.03, 0.5)s (utils.js:313)
section1_raf_loops.runs_when_minimized: yes - `forwards` animations already started keep running
section1_raf_loops.scale_risk: a 2000-track library creates 2000 simultaneous CSS animations at once (see section 5); delay is capped at 0.5s so they finish quickly, but all 2000 are created in the same frame batch

section2_listeners.passive_note: Only 3 of the 95 global addEventListener sites use { passive: true }; wheel is explicitly registered { passive: false } at main.js:562 because it calls preventDefault().
